item.title: [DEVELOPING] Hugging Face model malware campaign returns to hijack GPUs for crypto mining
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from BleepingComputer. A crypto-mining campaign abusing Hugging Face models returned days after takedown, hijacking GPU servers and planting backdoors. One model was downloaded over 28,000 times. A fake Solana kit also targets AI coding agents. Source: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hugging-face-malware-campaign-returns-to-hijack-gpus-for-crypto-mining

item.title: [DEVELOPING] Russian group Storm-1516 spreads AI deepfake video accusing Texas candidate Talarico
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from AI Incident Database. A Russian disinformation group reportedly spread AI-generated videos of a supposed former student accusing Talarico of misconduct. A fact-check rated the claim baseless. A network of accounts across major platforms pushed the content. Source: https://politifact.com/factchecks/2026/oct/22/tweets/russian-disinformation-group-targets-james-talarico-with-baseless-claim-in-ai-generated-video

item.title: [DEVELOPING] AI bots flood 2023 UK government consultation on disposable vapes ban
item.description: Unverified, auto-drafted from AI Incident Database. AI bots reportedly submitted tens of thousands of fake responses to a 2023 UK consultation, in a failed attempt to block the disposable vapes ban. Three-quarters of all responses were reportedly affected. Source: https://www.theguardian.com/society/2026/oct/27/ai-bots-flooded-2023-uk-government-consultation-disposable-vapes-ban
